name: Xiaomin Lin
title: Assistant Professor; ERA Lab Director
fitReason: Direct perception-to-action learning and foundation-model reasoning for underwater autonomy.

physicalEvidence.summary: DREAM v2 deploys VLM-guided exploration on a BlueROV2 with camera, IMU and Waterlinked DVL-A50 in a tank. Physical results are qualitative; comparative coverage/time percentages are simulation. Co-first author Zhenqi Wu is a current USF lab PhD student.

shortVisit.summary: Current explicit 2027 recruitment concerns PhD admission. The lab’s master’s section is for USF students and says funding is extremely unlikely. Collaboration inquiries are welcome, but no external-master’s short-visit pathway or eight-week invitation is established.

scoreReasons.fit: Strong embodied perception/reasoning and robot autonomy methods.
scoreReasons.physical: Named hardware, current-group co-first author and direct full-paper deployment; no exclusive platform ownership claimed.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: PhD/local-MS recruitment does not establish external short visits.
scoreReasons.freshness: February 2026 technical revision and current official affiliation/roster.

name: Ioannis Rekleitis
title: Associate Professor
fitReason: Marine robot autonomy and multi-robot sensing, with recent participation in embodied foundation-model navigation.
